# JSON parser dependency

Unmodified JSON for Modern C++ 3.12.0, under the adjacent MIT license. It provides parsing and owned JSON values; all Cane data, animation, constraints, geometry, and error semantics belong to Cane Core.

- Official release: https://github.com/nlohmann/json/releases/tag/v3.12.0
- Header: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nlohmann/json/v3.12.0/single_include/nlohmann/json.hpp
- Header SHA-256, verified against the official release: `aaf127c04cb31c406e5b04a63f1ae89369fccde6d8fa7cdda1ed4f32dfc5de63`
- License: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nlohmann/json/v3.12.0/LICENSE.MIT
- License SHA-256: `46a65cffd1ea955132d95a8dd921640714a8d6b537d2e4e482d31145ae95b603`

Core uses this dependency privately. It is not an engine adapter and does not execute another language runtime.
